title: Kiwi Fruit Kangaroo Bounce (All I Knew, All New)
style: happy hardcore meets phonk hybrid, 165 BPM, distorted Memphis cowbell loop on the offbeat, hard supersaw stabs on the chorus lift, gabber-adjacent kick pattern but bouncy not aggressive, sub-bass with kangaroo-bounce rhythm pattern, chopped vocal stutter on the hook, warm confident male english lead vocal half-rapped half-shouted with NZ-AU accent natural, soft female ad-lib gang-shout backing on the chorus, occasional pitched-up vocal chop, sun-soaked Auckland-Brisbane crossover mood, 336 hz subharmonic drone hidden under the sub-bass, vinyl crackle on the breakdowns, no auto-tune on the lead, big drop energy
lyrics:
[Intro — cowbell loop, then 808 stab]
(spoken low) Born in NZ. Grew up in AU. It was all I knew. It was all new.
Three-three-six. Bounce.

[Verse 1]
Kiwi fruit on the vine, kangaroo on the run
Born in Aotearoa, raised under the AU sun
Harbour Bridge to Sydney Bridge, two ports one heart
All I knew was both shores, that's where the song starts
Not a tourist, not a transplant, both passports paid
Bounce in the blood, that's the rhythm I made

[Pre-chorus — build, supersaws rising]
All I knew, all new, all I knew, all new
Bounce, bounce, bounce, the cowbell coming through
Kangaroo on the kick, kiwi on the snare
Three-three-six in the sub, cross-Tasman air

[CHORUS — drop, gabber kick + cowbell + supersaw stab]
KIWI FRUIT KANGAROO BOUNCE
BORN IN NZ, RAISED IN AU — EVERY OUNCE
ALL I KNEW, ALL NEW, BOTH SHORES THE SAME
THREE-THREE-SIX, BOUNCE, THAT'S THE NAME
(Backing): Bounce — bounce — bounce — bounce —
KIWI FRUIT KANGAROO BOUNCE
TASMAN SEA BETWEEN, BUT THE HEART DON'T RENOUNCE
ALL I KNEW, ALL NEW, ALL I KNEW, ALL NEW
THREE-THREE-SIX BOUNCE COMING THROUGH

[Verse 2]
Wellington wind, Brisbane heat, both in the lungs
Maori-Pakeha-Aussie-Kiwi, every tongue
McIvor on the manifest, captain on the deck
Twenty-six songs across oceans, no respect lost, no wreck
Kangaroo doesn't ask permission to jump
Kiwi doesn't apologise for the night-call thump

[Pre-chorus]
All I knew, all new, all I knew, all new
Bounce, bounce, bounce, the cowbell coming through
Kangaroo on the kick, kiwi on the snare
Three-three-six in the sub, cross-Tasman air

[CHORUS]
KIWI FRUIT KANGAROO BOUNCE
BORN IN NZ, RAISED IN AU — EVERY OUNCE
ALL I KNEW, ALL NEW, BOTH SHORES THE SAME
THREE-THREE-SIX, BOUNCE, THAT'S THE NAME

[Bridge — half-time, vinyl crackle, sub-bass only]
It was all I knew because it was all I had
It was all new because every day was the lad
Learning two anthems, two flags, one heart
Kangaroo and kiwi never came apart
Bounce on the wire, bounce on the shore
Three-three-six — always asking for more

[CHORUS final — full drop, gang shouts]
KIWI FRUIT KANGAROO BOUNCE
BORN IN NZ, RAISED IN AU — EVERY OUNCE
ALL I KNEW, ALL NEW, BOTH SHORES THE SAME
THREE-THREE-SIX, BOUNCE, THAT'S THE NAME
KIWI FRUIT KANGAROO BOUNCE
TASMAN SEA BETWEEN, BUT THE HEART DON'T RENOUNCE

[Outro — cowbell loop fades, spoken last line]
All I knew. All new. Both shores. One heart.
Three-three-six. Bounce.
